Library.title: Local asset library
Library.description: Project-isolated local assets for characters, props, scenes, sounds and videos. Organizing assets never calls an AI model.
Library.projectFoldersHint: Choose a project folder. Files and annotations are never shared across projects automatically.
Library.detailsHint: Local file, generation prompt and recorded provenance. No API credentials are exposed.
Library.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select and copy the text manually.
Library.noProvenance: This is an imported asset or has no recorded generation source.
Library.traceNotProvided: No separate trace code was supplied or recorded. Task IDs are not embedded video watermark codes.
Library.search: Search names, tags, notes or prompts
Library.folderHint: Import files here, or put files into the local category folder and scan. Files are not uploaded to the cloud.
Library.missingFile: Category copy is missing; the original project asset is preserved.
Library.canvasFailed: Could not add this asset to Canvas.
Library.metadataHint: Names, tags, notes and reusable prompts stay local. The original generation prompt is not overwritten.
Library.copyHint: Copy into a category of this project only. The original file is not moved or removed.

BatchExport.title: Export {count} asset(s)
BatchExport.description: A single asset is copied out as a plain file; two or more are packed into one zip by default. Originals always stay in place and name clashes get a number suffix.
BatchExport.targetHint: Use an absolute local path. Defaults to the export folder from Settings and is created if missing. App data, project material and library folders are not allowed.
BatchExport.zipTooMany: A single archive holds at most {max} assets. Export in smaller batches or switch to the folder mode.
BatchExport.zipLimitHint: {count} asset(s) will be packed into one archive (limit: {max} assets / {gb} GB per archive).
BatchExport.modeZipHint: Writes one archive into the target folder. Nothing goes to the browser download folder.
BatchExport.modeFolderHint: Copies each file into the target folder. Name clashes get a number suffix; existing files are never overwritten.
BatchExport.singleMetadataHint: A single asset exports as a file only, with no json.
BatchExport.includeMetadata: Also export prompts and provenance (matching .seedance.json file)
BatchExport.metadataWarning: File exported, but provenance could not be written:
BatchExport.skippedType: Skipped {count} item(s) whose type does not fit that category

CanvasTools.textPlaceholder: Write a prompt, character description or shot notes…
CanvasTools.instructionPlaceholder: For example: add cinematic detail, preserve the story
CanvasTools.optimizationHint: Only AI Optimize sends this text to your API and may incur a charge. Preview the suggestion before replacing the original.
CanvasTools.textChanged: The original changed. Save the suggestion as a new text node instead of overwriting it.
CanvasTools.suggestionReady: Suggestion ready; the original is unchanged
CanvasTools.textPromptTooLong: Generation prompts allow {max} characters. Shorten the text first; the original node is preserved.
CanvasTools.textResultTooLong: The result exceeds the text node limit of 20000 characters. Shorten the input or instructions.

CanvasTools.folderDeleteHint: The nodes inside stay in this project and move up one level.
CanvasTools.folderDissolved: Subproject deleted; its nodes moved up one level
CanvasTools.folderDepthLimit: Two levels of subprojects at most: this level cannot hold another folder.
CanvasTools.upscalePlaceholder: Upscale entry reserved. The local engine is not connected; no job is created and no media is uploaded.
CanvasTools.upscaleDialogHint: Runs on this computer with the bundled local engine. The result is saved as a new project asset next to this node; the original is untouched. Upscale and interpolation run as separate nodes.
CanvasTools.upscaleEngineMissing: The local upscale engine was not found.
CanvasTools.upscaleNotEligible: Select one image or video card that is saved to this project before upscaling.
CanvasTools.upscaleJobLost: The local server stopped while this job was running. Start it again.
CanvasTools.upscaleCancelFailed: Cancel failed: the engine may still be running. This node keeps syncing its real status.
CanvasTools.upscaleSourceGone: The source node for this upscale no longer exists.
CanvasTools.upscaleTaskHint: Upscale only. For 60 fps, switch to interpolation and run it as a separate node: doing both at once is much slower and harder to diagnose.
CanvasTools.upscaleInterpolateHint: Interpolation only. Resolution stays as-is; run a separate upscale node if you also need more pixels.
CanvasTools.upscaleCustomHint: Set one side only; the other follows the source aspect ratio. The engine rejects a request that supplies both.
CanvasTools.upscaleCustomRange: Enter a value from 64 to 16384 px.
CanvasTools.upscaleSettingsHint: These settings belong to this node and are read when a job starts.
CanvasTools.upscaleRerunHint: This node already has a result. Processing with new settings creates a new node and keeps the current result.
CanvasTools.upscaleSetupTitle: First run: open the tool once
CanvasTools.upscaleSetupHint: Run one upscale and one interpolation by hand in SnowLeopard Vision first. That confirms the GPU, warms the model caches, and lets the same project work on another machine.
CanvasTools.upscaleGuiMissing: SnowLeopard Vision.exe was not found. Put the tool next to the app, or configure upscale-gui-root.txt in the data folder.
CanvasTools.upscaleLaunchFailed: The tool could not be opened.
CanvasTools.upscaleLaunchMissingHint: The tool folder was not found. Check data/upscale-gui-root.txt.
CanvasTools.upscaleLaunchExitedHint: The tool started and exited immediately. On this machine it must run from a normal folder, not the agent workspace. Point data/upscale-gui-root.txt at a working install, or put the tool folder next to the app.
CanvasTools.upscaleManualUpscale: I ran one upscale by hand
CanvasTools.upscaleManualInterpolate: I ran one interpolation by hand
CanvasTools.upscaleSetupRequired: Finish both checks, or skip, before starting a job.
CanvasTools.upscaleSetupSaveFailed: The first-run state could not be saved.

ModelConnections.description: Connect your own video, image and text models. Credentials remain encrypted on this computer.

ModelConnections.testHint: Saving never calls a model. Connection tests read models/tasks when supported; otherwise only configuration is checked, not authentication. Text optimization calls the real API. Images/videos are never auto-generated for testing.

LocalWorkspace.directoryHint: Project files and the asset library use separate folders. Changing a folder copies existing files without overwriting unrelated files; the old folder is kept.

Seedance.description: Local projects and media. Generate through your own Ark account.
